scheme1_name: CBSE Merit Scholarship Scheme for Single Girl Child (SGC)
scheme2_name: Post Graduate Indira Gandhi Scholarship for Single Girl Child (PG-IGSSGC)

comparisons.scheme1_value: Single girl students in classes 11-12 in CBSE schools who scored 70%+ in class 10. Age not specified.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Single girl students admitted to first year of postgraduate (master's) courses in recognised universities. Must be ≤30 years old. No brothers allowed; sisters are okay.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Rs. 1,000 per month for maximum 24 months (classes 11-12). Total: Rs. 24,000 over 2 years.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Rs. 36,200 per year for full PG duration (typically 2 years). Total: approximately Rs. 72,400 over 2 years.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Family gross income ≤ Rs. 8,00,000 per annum (must be proven by attested affidavit).
comparisons.scheme2_value: No income limit mentioned in official records.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Strict caps: ≤Rs. 2,500/month in class 10; ≤Rs. 3,000/month in classes 11-12 (NRI: ≤Rs. 6,000/month). Exceeding this makes you ineligible.
comparisons.scheme2_value: No fee cap mentioned. Only requirement: admission to regular, full-time, recognised institution.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Regular classroom studies in CBSE-affiliated schools (classes 11-12 only).
comparisons.scheme2_value: Regular, full-time postgraduate courses only. Distance education is NOT eligible.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Direct Bank Transfer via ECS/NEFT to Aadhaar-linked bank account.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode; paid annually via PFMS.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Aadhaar card, class 10 mark sheet, admission proof, student ID, passport photo, signature, fee receipt (school-verified), income affidavit on Rs. 50 stamp paper (attested by Gazetted Officer/SDM/First-Class Magistrate), undertaking with photo (school-attested).
comparisons.scheme2_value: Aadhaar card, proof of admission to master's course, joining report (Annexure-I), affidavit of single-girl-child status (Annexure-II), bank passbook copy, birth certificate OR class 10 mark sheet. Post-award: progress report with marks + funds utilisation certificate.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Online at cbse.gov.in/cbsenew/scholar.html. Steps: New User Registration → enter class 10 roll number + DOB → download undertaking and affidavit templates → fill, get school attestation → scan as PDFs (max 1 MB) → upload → print confirmation. Renewals: courier signed confirmation to CBSE Delhi office.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Online at scholarships.gov.in (National Scholarships Portal). Steps: Register on NSP → verify mobile with OTP → complete eKYC → install AadhaarFaceRD app → generate OTR ID with FaceAuth → log in with OTR → fill form → upload documents → Final Submit. Track payments via PFMS.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Application windows notified yearly on CBSE website. Check current session dates on cbse.gov.in/cbsenew/scholar.html.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Applications invited once per year on NSP. Short notifications posted on UGC website. Incomplete applications are rejected immediately.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Valid until class 12 completion. Renewal required; must submit class 11 mark sheet for renewal in class 12. Good conduct and regular attendance mandatory.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Single-year application for first year of PG. If funds are approved, continue through PG duration (typically 2 years) if progress reports + utilisation certificates are submitted.

comparisons.scheme1_value: Only girl child (twins/all girls born together count as single girl child). If family has one son and one daughter, girl is NOT eligible.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Only girl child (twins/fraternal daughters okay). If family has one son and one daughter, girl is NOT eligible.

comparisons.scheme1_value: No cap mentioned; merit-based on class 10 marks.
comparisons.scheme2_value: Limited to 3,000 fresh scholarships per year (highly competitive).

comparisons.scheme1_value: Indian nationals and NRI students (NRI with higher fee cap).
comparisons.scheme2_value: Indian citizens only (no mention of NRI eligibility).
Postgraduate level (master's degree courses, first year only).

recommendation: These are two **different** schemes for different stages of education, so choose based on your situation: **SCHEME 1 (CBSE-SGC)** is for high school girls scoring 70%+ in class 10 with family income ≤Rs. 8 lakh/year, studying in CBSE schools. Provides Rs. 1,000/month for 2 years. **SCHEME 2 (PG-IGSSGC)** is for postgraduate (master's) students ≤30 years old with no upper income limit, but only 3,000 awards nationally per year, paying Rs. 36,200/year. If you are in class 11-12 and meet CBSE-SGC criteria (70%+ in class 10, ≤Rs. 8 lakh family income, school fees within caps), **apply for Scheme 1**. If you are pursuing a master's degree (first year) and are a single girl child with no brothers, **apply for Scheme 2** via the National Scholarships Portal. **Disclaimer:** This is AI guidance based on official context provided. For final decisions, verify on official websites (cbse.gov.in for Scheme 1; scholarships.gov.in for Scheme 2) and contact scheme administrators directly. This is not a legal or official notification.
